title: Emergency!
description:

An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E13 — Drivers
An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.

title: Emergency!
description:

The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E3 — Where Is the Monster When You Need Him?
The team uses monster-movie special effects to combat a war criminal terrorizing Mexican villagers; guest Dennis Cole.

title: The A-Team
description:

A land developer's takeover of a Chicago neighborhood results in an attack on B.A.'s mother (Della Reese).

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E5 — The Road to Hope
Murdock zealously recruits derelicts to rescue his compatriots from paramilitary captors; guest Elisha Cook.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E6 — The Heart of Rock 'n' Roll
Rock star Rick James (as himself) calls on the team when he discovers that inmates are threatening his imprisoned buddy (Isaac Hayes).

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E7 — Body Slam
Wrestler Hulk Hogan calls on old Vietnam buddy B.A. when mobsters threaten to close a friend's youth center.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E8 — Blood, Sweat and Cheers
B.A. drives in a stock car race to prevent Hannibal's nephew (Ken Olandt) being run off the track by thugs; guest Stuart Whitman.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E9 — Mind Games
Pardoned Face's book-promotion TV tour hits a snag when a Viet Cong general seeks revenge for his jilted daughter.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E10 — There Goes the Neighborhood
The team conceals in suburbia a rock singer threatened by terrorists, until a nosy neighbor blows the whistle.

title: The A-Team
description:
S4 E11 — The Doctor Is Out
The team journeys to a South American jungle to rescue Murdock's kidnapped therapist (Richard Anderson); guest Jeannetta Arnette.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E22 — Nine Hours
Hit men kidnap a child to force Banner to cooperate in their killing of a hospitalized mob witness.
